originalBuildCommitEvidence: Original frozen baseline-hashes.json.commit and run.py HEAD.
sourceRule: Execution HEAD must descend from the original build anchor. Git diff must show no Sources, Tests, Scripts, Package.swift or Package.resolved change. Root must be clean.
modesAndGates: serial/legacy/new, then new/legacy/serial only if both first new/legacy and new/serial whole-decode ratios are <= 0.95, with exact causal/state checks.
guards: Fresh launch free >= 50%; internal and external live free >= 30%; owned-child deadline 420s.
timing: Request means prompt through decode finish. Model load is excluded. Original timing limits apply.
observations: Own PID ps RSS is recorded with the existing 2s memory samples. RSS is resident set, not physical footprint. No phase claim is made without driver markers.
preservation: All original files, receipts, source, binary and stage manifest remain unchanged. No rebuild.
verification: Static Python AST/compile and JSON checks only. No preflight, comparison, tests, builds or model runs.
